text: Cerf and Kahn's 1974 design assumed almost nothing about the constituent networks. Why?
choices: Because the three networks being joined had different packet sizes, error characteristics and administrators who would not change
explanation: They did not try to make the networks the same; they proposed a gateway and a common packet format, with each network carrying it by whatever internal means it liked. Assuming almost nothing is what let IP later run over Wi-Fi, LTE and everything since without amendment.
